svg.title: University of Thrantorbury — illustrated campus plan
svg.desc: North-up proposed university map following Nico's hand sketch. Three dorm enclaves in the northwest, northeast and southwest; faculty residences north of the main campus; administration behind Public Administration; a central Quad fountain; Maritime Studies beside the Grounds lagoon near Evocation. Architectural forms, paths and leisure details are illustrative, not surveyed. No Awakened Library.
